$comment: Which repositories are on the Atlas, where each sits on the map and which zone it belongs to. Everything else about a repository comes from its own atlas.json (or data/fallback/<id>.json when it has none). x/y are map coordinates for a wide window (the map is about 1700 x 1050); tall is [x, y] for a phone held upright (about 1000 x 1650, the zones stacked top to bottom), and every repository needs both. Laid out on 2026-11-02 by a search that keeps each zone in its place, Flood-Net in the middle, and the lines off other repositories and each other. To add a repository: add an entry here, give it an atlas.json (template in docs/adding-a-repo.md), push. Optional, for the Priorities view (docs/priorities.md): a repository's weight, 1 to 5, says how much it matters now (left out, the Atlas guesses from its phase and what relies on it); a top-level triage object holds how open work is weighed (weights, your hours a day, agent sessions at once, what an hour of yours is worth).
